 Joe Jonas Recalls Turning Ex Demi Lovato’s Decade-Old Meme Into ‘Special’ Birthday Gift
 November 18, 2026 
 By
 Ayusi Adhikari 
 Joe Jonas has found a sweet way to keep an old joke alive with his former girlfriend, Demi Lovato . More than a decade after her viral interview about mugs, the singer still enjoys the moment. He recently shared that the joke even inspired a gift for Lovato. His brothers, Kevin and Nick Jonas, also joined in on the fun.
 Joe Jonas remembers sending Demi Lovato a mug for her birthday
 During the Nov. 17 episode of the brothers’ Hey Jonas! podcast , Joe brought up Lovato’s famous answer. “It’s amazing,” he said while discussing the viral clip with Kevin and Nick. Joe recalled buying her a mug as a present when she recently joined them as a special guest. He then admitted he could not remember whether he sent it for her birthday, saying, I bought her a mug as a gift for coming as our special guest recently or her birthday. I think I sent her a mug for her birthday. I can’t remember.
 Kevin also enjoyed the moment and pointed out that Lovato had not been wrong. “She wasn’t incorrect,” he said. Nick agreed with the joke, adding, “I too love mugs.” Lovato first made the comment during an interview with NRJ Berlin more than 10 years ago, when she called mugs her “favorite dish.”
 Lovato later explained the story behind her unusual answer during an appearance on Keke Palmer’s Baby, It’s Keke Palmer podcast in March. She said the interviewer had asked about food, but she deliberately chose to talk about cookware instead. She had already answered a lot of questions during a press tour and felt bored with it at that time. “I’m gonna start f–king with the interviewers,” she recalled thinking before deciding to run with the joke.
 Lovato also said the full interview showed her smiling at her tour manager after giving the answer. She joked that the viral clip made people believe she had taken the question seriously. In the original moment, she explained that mugs feel comfortable to hold and let people enjoy hot drinks without touching them directly. Joe’s gift shows that the funny exchange still brings a smile, even years after it first caught fans’ attention.
